excerpt: Calculate net rental yield for a Dubai apartment using collected rent, owner expenses and the full acquisition cost.
introduction:
Net rental yield estimates the annual operating income from a property as a percentage of the capital used to acquire it. For a Dubai apartment, start with realistic rent, allow for vacancy and deduct owner-paid costs such as service charges, management, repairs and insurance. Divide the result by the full acquisition cost.

The calculation is a planning tool, not a guaranteed return. The example below uses sample numbers; replace them with current lease evidence, unit-specific charges and written transaction quotes.
takeaways: Net operating income equals expected rent less vacancy and owner-paid operating costs.
Use the purchase price plus acquisition and initial setup costs as the denominator when comparing investments.
Keep mortgage payments, tax, capital gains and sale costs separate from an unleveraged operating yield.

sections.heading: What is the net rental yield formula?
sections.body:
First estimate annual rent that the unit can reasonably achieve using recent signed leases for comparable apartments. Subtract an allowance for vacancy or uncollected rent. Then subtract the owner's recurring operating costs. The result is net operating income, or NOI.

Divide NOI by the total acquisition cost and multiply by 100. Total acquisition cost can include the price, buyer-paid registration and brokerage, initial repairs and furnishing. Make clear which costs are included so that two properties are compared on the same basis.

Gross yield is often quoted as annual rent divided by the purchase price. It can be useful as a first screen, but it leaves out vacancy and costs and may therefore overstate income available to an owner.

table.note: All inputs are examples; finance, tax and sale costs are excluded.

sections.heading: Work through the example
sections.body:
Assume an apartment costs AED 1,000,000 and acquisition and initial setup costs add AED 50,000, making AED 1,050,000 invested. Assume AED 90,000 annual rent, AED 7,500 vacancy allowance, AED 12,000 service charges, AED 4,500 management, AED 3,500 repairs and AED 1,000 insurance.

Net operating income is AED 90,000 minus AED 28,500 of allowances and costs, or AED 61,500. Divide by AED 1,050,000 and multiply by 100: approximately 5.86%. Gross rent divided by the price alone is 9%, but the two measures use different inputs and denominators.

The chart shows the example's rent, deductions and resulting income. These bars are parts of one calculation and should not be added as separate income. None of the numbers is a current Dubai rent, price or return.

chart.title: Example annual rental calculation
chart.note: Sample figures; NOI equals rent less deductions. Finance, tax and eventual sale costs are excluded.

sections.heading: Find realistic rent and vacancy inputs
sections.body:
Ask for recent signed leases in the same building where possible and compare the bedroom count, size, condition, floor, parking, furnishing and included services. Record the lease date and any rent-free period. An asking rent is not evidence of a signed lease or the time needed to find a tenant.

Choose a vacancy allowance that reflects your evidence and risk tolerance, then test a longer empty period. A unit may also need time between tenants for repairs or cleaning. If the apartment is not ready, do not assume rent starts on the advertised handover date.

The [JVC and Arjan area guide](/journal/jvc-vs-arjan-apartment-investment-comparison) shows how to compare two communities at building level. An area average cannot establish the rent for a particular unit.

sections.heading: Check each owner cost
sections.body:
Request the unit's current service-charge statement and payment dates. DLD's [service charge index](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/eservices/service-charge-index/) provides an official lookup for approved community charges; confirm the relevant rate, area basis and any arrears for the exact property. Charges differ between buildings and can change.

Add the owner's management fee, maintenance, insurance and other costs under the proposed lease. Separate a building service charge from a property manager's fee and avoid counting the same invoice twice. Ask whether quoted service fees include applicable tax.

For the denominator, request an itemised quote. DLD's [property sale registration service](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/eservices/property-sale-registration/) lists charges for completed-property transfers; actual allocation and other costs depend on the agreement.

sections.heading: What does the yield leave out?
sections.body:
The example is before mortgage interest and principal, tax, changes in property value and costs of sale. A mortgaged owner's cash flow can differ substantially from NOI. Prepare a separate schedule of rent collected, operating expenses and loan payments, and track the outstanding principal.

A yield based on one year's assumptions does not measure total return over the full holding period. The future sale price, purchase and sale dates, renovation and changing rent all matter. A higher projected yield can also reflect a higher price, vacancy or repair risk.

Run a lower-rent, longer-vacancy and higher-charge scenario. If the property only works under the most optimistic case, revisit the price and reserve.

sections.heading: Compare properties on a consistent basis
sections.body:
Use the same twelve-month period and treatment of costs for every candidate. If one apartment is furnished, include the purchase or replacement cost of its furniture; if another is not, do not assume its setup cost is zero. Record whether parking and utilities are included in the rent and adjust the comparison accordingly.

Keep a note beside each input identifying its source and date. A recent signed lease, a building statement and a written acquisition quote provide stronger evidence than three headline estimates. When an input is unavailable, show a range and the effect on NOI rather than filling the gap with an apparently precise figure.

sections.heading: Apply the method to current options
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Dubai project collection](/projects?emirate=Dubai) and [contact Aliyas](/contact) with your budget, preferred area and intended tenant. Ask which units are currently available and request the price, plan and building costs.

Use the exact property's documents and comparable lease evidence to calculate your own estimate. A project page or the worked example does not guarantee a yield.
